title: 28th Day
data:
اَللّٰهُمَّ وَفِّرْ حَظِّىْ فِيْهِ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ، وَ اَكْرِمْنِىْ فِيْهِ بِاِحْضَارِ الْمَسَاۤئِلِ، وَ قَرِّبْ فِيْهِ وَسِيْلَتِىْ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْوَسَآئِلِ، يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهٗ اِلْحَاحُ الْمُلِحِّيْنَ.
ALLAAHUMMA WAFFIR HAZZEE FEEHE MENAN NAWAAFELE WA AKRIMNEE FEEHE BE-EHZAARIL MASAA-ELE WA QARRIB FEEHE WASEELATEE ELAYKA MIM BAYNIL WASAA-ELE YAA MAN LAA YASHGHALOHU IL-HAA-HUL MOLEHHEENA.
O Allah, on this day, decide for me a share of the supererogatory acts, honor me by making me care for the matters, and make near my means to You from among the other means. O He Whom is not preoccupied by the earnest entreaty of the insisters!
